newsitem.title: USA: Silver Peak venture ready to start drilling.
newsitem.headline: Silver Peak venture ready to start drilling.

text.p: Silver Peak Resources Ltd's Williston Basin venture will begin its first exploratory well in 45 to 60 days, President Richard J. Watson said Friday.

Over the past two years, the venture has acquired a property package of 38,500 acres of leases. Silver Peak has a 25 percent working interest, as does an affiliated company, Golden Arch Resources. A private company owned by principals of Silver Peak and Golden Arch holds another 15 percent and Navasoth Resources the remaining 35 percent, he told investors.
Navasoth is negotiating $10 million of financing to fund its share of the drilling and other projects, Watson noted.

He said Silver Peak has funds on hand for one and a half wells, adding it needs to raise $2.6 million for the venture's planned drilling program seeking reserves in the Red River formation in the Williston Basin area of eastern Montana.
Once two successful wells are completed, Watson said, the company will be "bankable" -- able to borrow the needed funds from banks.
Until then, he said, it is seeking to fund operations with the "least equity dilution possible."
He described that stock as "thinly traded with good support at $0.90." It has not traded today and is quoted at $0.96 bid and $1.03 asked on the Vancouver Exchange.
